content: OpenXcom (open-source XCOM) splits state into SavedGame (strategic: Base, Craft, Soldier, Ufo) and SavedBattleGame (tactical: BattleUnit). BattlescapeGenerator builds tactical state from Geoscape state at encounter time; DebriefingState.prepareDebriefing() writes results back: soldier wound-recovery days, deaths/MIA, items recovered to craft inventory, Craft::returnToBase()/setMissionComplete, Base facility destruction, score. Geoscape time advances in steps that drive craft movement, research, construction. Strategy layer is paused while Battlescape runs (state stack). Confirmed by deepwiki summary and DebriefingState.cpp source.
